response.overview: Free Speech Costs Plenty is the story of a veteran Stand Up Comedian Dorian Spence, who tries to navigate his desire to tell the truth in a current climate of a crackdown on the 1st Amendment. This conflict becomes more pressurized in light of the Jimmy Kimmel suspension, and the cancellation of Stephen Colbert who both have been critical of the current president of the U.S and his administration.
response.title: Free Speech Costs Plenty
